title: Vampyrates! #4
desc:
Prepare for boarding! Swords and fangs are about to clash now that the Abyss faces capture!

Admiral Penance of the Church's Holy Fleet has captured Captain Akeyo and the crew of the Abyss, and the only person who can save them is Nira.

We can only be sure of one thing when one lone vampyrate faces a battleship full of sword-wielding fanatics: Blood will be spilled. Gallons and gallons of blood.

But will it also mean survival in the end?
